description: React component for rendering the dashboard side navigation menu with links, icons, and optional bottom content including a logout button.

methods.name: DashboardNav({ logout, bottomContent })
methods.description: Functional React component rendering the dashboard sidebar with navigation links, icons, active route highlighting, and optional bottom content.

parameters.name: logout
parameters.description: Callback function invoked when the logout button is clicked.

parameters.name: bottomContent
parameters.description: Optional React node displayed at the bottom of the sidebar, e.g., theme toggler.
